name: Deepdelver Tau
desc:
Deepdelver Tau is a Ganymede NPC. They're a Deepdelver of [the Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union).

Tau is in charge of dispatching people on expeditions into the [Saramaed Hollow](location:saramaed_hollow) and bringing the Deep Drill back to the surface when a signal is called via the radio communication system inside the drill.
additional_info:
-   Tau only allows a maximum of five (5) people to enter at once.
-   Tau's hair id is 4997293129.
